state_attribution_scope: measured-interval semantic ID/reason counts only; correlated publications, not a one-to-one frame cause; at most 64 pairs; no values
processor_count_scope: Environment.ProcessorCount respects affinity, quota and DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT; not necessarily whole-machine CPU capacity
scheduler_scope: host admission leases and queues; not OS HTTP connections or disk I/O counters
managed_live_bytes_scope: GC.GetTotalMemory(false) estimate; baseline and final after explicit full GC
allocation_scope: process total includes fixture, one-second Process/JSON observer and explicit final GC; not product idle allocation
gate_scope: bounded fixture endpoint retention; not monotonic-trend or runtime KPI certification
timing_scope: intent-plus-render; 0.1ms histogram upper bounds below 100ms; saturated percentile is null, max is exact; no OS backend
